title: Two jobs for a rule
alt: Two archways show a stair rail on the left and a swing on the right, with empty space in front.
scene: Two simple archways side by side on a plain background. Through the left arch a stair rail is visible; through the right a playground swing. Empty floor in front of both, no people.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Wide lesson composition with generous clean margins. Two simple archways side by side on a plain background. Through the left arch a stair rail is visible; through the right a playground swing. Empty floor in front of both, no people. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
